name: tribe-coding
description: Tribe Coding plugins for Claude Code: PlantUML diagram sync, custom statusline, and more

plugins.name: plantuml
plugins.description: PlantUML diagram automation: auto-sync URLs in markdown, pre-commit validation, CI checks

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Custom Claude Code statusline with API rate limits, context window, git info

plugins.name: statusline-compact
plugins.description: Compact single-line Claude Code statusline with brightness-coded API usage

plugins.name: git-branch-naming
plugins.description: Git branch naming convention enforcement: validates names, warns on content mismatch

plugins.name: retroscope
plugins.description: Retrospective session reports: summarize tasks, decisions, and open questions from Claude Code sessions

plugins.name: playbook
plugins.description: Curated presets of coding guidelines injected into sessions on demand

plugins.name: semver
plugins.description: Semantic versioning enforcement: validates version bumps before commit/push/PR, supports multiple version files
